g.text: Sequence Diagram - VIS05 Viewer Lighting Lifecycle
Mount viewer with request and module factories
Read active configuration and preload its assets
Configuration + assets, or existing load outcome
[Unsupported, denied, empty, invalid or load failure]
[Current attempt has a valid layout and assets]
Scene geometry and mesh shadow flags
Fit world bounds; attach lights and target;
enable PCF and mark spotlight shadow dirty
Capture room and filter radiance once
Rethrow to existing build failure path
Initial shadow map and environment-lit frame
Frame reusing environment and shadow maps, or render exception
[Reload, exit, role loss or render/context failure]
Restore prior environment and intensity if still owned;
detach group; release spotlight and environment target
via context disposer; clear owned references
